description: One incident by id (as this server's results give it) with its tier, dates, figures, summary and the source records that establish it. A California source record can carry `noticeLetter`, a passage quoted from its notice letter, with a credit line. An id can be retired, for example when its incident is merged into another, re-minted under its own organization, or replaced after a rollback; a retired id returns the current incident, with redirectedFrom naming the id asked for. An incident id made from a slug that named a person who is not the organization (for example, an officer named in the filer's name) is withdrawn, not retired: it is not found (the API answers 404, with no redirect), and its incident goes on under another id. Records are verified from regulator filings and Have I Been Pwned; a threat actor's claim is never a source. A miss means there is no record here, not that no breach happened. Counts from different sources are not additive.
name: get_incident
title: Get one incident
